g.text: Lab 1.2 — RBAC: who, what, and where
A role assignment is a triple: principal + role definition + scope — and it flows downward
Owner is assigned once at the subscription — all three groups inherit it, it is never repeated per RG
member of SkyCraft-Testers → Reader on dev-skycraft-swc-rg
There is no "deny" role. To stop something, remove the assignment or use Azure Policy (Lab 1.3).
the three built-in roles this lab uses
